race.description: Sportsbet Same Race Multi F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: MADAM MONEYBAGS (3) pushed hard from a wide gate to sit outside the lead then gave her all but was narrowly defeated first-up from a 12-month spell over 1100m at Gawler last start. Will tighten right up following that hit-out. Draws in much closer today so she gets a terrific chance to break through. ARTISON (8) returned from an eight-week let-up with an eye-catching third last time out over 1100m at Gawler, coming from last after a slow start. Consistent filly who will want to jump a bit better today from the inside stall but if things go right she is a super chance. ARIZONA DREAMER (7) is back for a second campaign off a 20-week break. Beaten narrowly on debut over this trip at Balaklava and a recent jump-out win suggests she is ready for another strong fresh performance. MYSTRIX (4) resumes. Might find this a bit sharp but did sprint well when fresh over 1200m last prep. PALACE LORE (12) is a first starter with plenty of trial experience. Well found in early betting.
